scenes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-bleed cinematic environment background for an academic portfolio's immersive scrolling journey, not a website mockup.
Style/medium: premium feature-film anime environment matte painting, beautifully restrained painterly stylization with physically rich atmospheric light and coherent natural materials. Elegant advertising-grade cinematography, monumental scale, exquisite controlled detail, minimal clean silhouettes. This is one act of a coherent three-act film inspired by the exploratory atmosphere of Hunter × Hunter, without depicting any characters or recognizable scenes.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape, ideally 2048x1152. A strong distant vanishing point slightly right of center; a path draws the viewer inward. Keep the left 45 percent dark, spacious, low-contrast and visually quiet for white website copy. Concentrate environmental depth and restrained light center-right. Leave a clear uncluttered lower-right foreground for an external character overlay; DO NOT draw the overlay. Full-bleed image, no border or letterboxing.
Shared lighting vocabulary: deep near-black shadows, layered volumetric mist, a narrow light opening on the distant horizon, rich yet limited color, substantial negative space, realistic atmospheric perspective.
Constraints: environment only. Absolutely NO people, characters, human silhouettes, faces, creatures, crowds, text, lettering, logos, watermark, captions, UI, icons, network diagrams, circuitry, sci-fi machinery, collage panels, or decorative framing. No giant foreground object blocking the lower-right overlay area.
Primary request: ACT I — CURIOSITY. Create a vast lush ancient forest opening onto an immense misty mountainous valley. A modest weathered stone-and-earth trail passes through restrained foreground leaves and mossy stone, winding from the bottom toward the luminous distant center-right valley. Monumental mountain slopes recede in soft layered mist beyond tall forest silhouettes.
Lighting/mood: emerald and teal dawn, a few soft shafts of early sunlight breaking into the valley; hopeful, hushed awe at entering an unknown world. Keep the overall frame dark and cinematic, with the glow narrow and distant rather than a bright sky filling the picture.
Color palette and materials: deep charcoal greens, muted emerald foliage, blue-green mist, wet dark stone, refined natural leaf and moss texture. Focused detail near the trail, quieter peripheral shadows. The lower-right landing is spacious and simple, not filled with dense plants.

Vast cliff silhouettes and receding high ridges reveal a route through uncertainty. The bridge's simple geometry is legible and grounded, not fantastical machinery.
Lighting/mood: deep blue night, a very narrow cool horizon opening, sparse electric-cyan atmospheric highlights filtering through mist, delicate pale rim light on the route. Quiet concentration, danger suggested only by depth, clarity emerging from darkness.
Color palette and materials: near-black charcoal, midnight blue, restrained blue-gray rock, cyan only as subtle natural atmospheric light, damp dark stone.
